the count is attained by genuine lifting nodes, so it is exact and not merely an upper bound: f_{c,b}(x) = 3^r c + b x has the origin as a level-r node with residual exactly c + b x along the all-zeros word, and adding 3^r x^2 contributes 3^{2r} x^2 which is invisible modulo 3^r, so the attainment is not an artefact of degree 1

block shift law: for a word w of length j the section operators send the state (3^j d, 3^{j+i}) to (d + 3^i packWord(w), 3^{j+i}), every such word survives, and at i = 0, j = e the 3^e words of length e reach exactly the states d + t for t in the balanced window W_e = [-(3^e-1)/2, (3^e-1)/2]; the shift is the balanced value packWord(w) and NOT the digit sum, and the distinction is load bearing because W_e is a complete residue system modulo 3^e while the digit sums are only the 2e+1 values |s| <= e

the shifted family separates residues: for every e >= 1 and R >= 0 the map d mod 3^R -> (B_R(d+t))_{t in W_e} is injective, where B_R is the depth-R behaviour of (d+t, 3^e) and W_e is the window of BTL-block-shift; proof by induction on R, using that W_e contains exactly one t_0 with 3^e dividing d + t_0, that t_0 is the unique window entry whose behaviour has depth at least min(e,R) when R > e, and that its entry carries the family of d' = (d+t_0)/3^e at horizon R - e; this closes the 3^{r-e} + e row count for all e, and it is false for the digit-sum window, where d = 3 and d = 6 modulo 9 collide at e = 2

normal form for the minimal deep-regime state: scale by a unit so that b = 3^e with e = min(v_3(b), r); then if v_3(c) < e the depth-r behaviour is the fully ternary tree truncated at depth v_3(c) and depends on v_3(c) alone, giving r classes, while if v_3(c) >= e the behaviour is exactly the unit-scaling orbit of (c, b) modulo 3^r with no further collapse, giving (3^{r+1}-1)/2 classes, and L_r is the sum; so the minimal state is the unit orbit degenerated to v_3(c) where the constant dominates the derivative, which identifies the quotient with classical Newton-polygon dominance plus Hensel rigidity and is why the branch closes as a reparameterization; bijection with behaviour classes verified for r <= 4

for Γ_NP, if E_|v|(s)=E_|v|(t) then T_v(s) lands on F iff T_v(t) does; length-n suffix acceptance is classified by E_n, not by residual coordinates. This is fold_on_F_iff, not a bound on L_0

for F(x)=x^2 and the infinite output language Y={0,+}^ω that never emits -1, the language L of trit words whose residual outputs of F all lie in {0,+} is not regular; equivalently the 3-adic preimage X=F^{-1}(Y) is not sofic. The prefixes 10^m are pairwise Myhill-Nerode inequivalent because the residual g_m(x)=3^{m+1}x^2+2x accepts w_m=(-1)^{m+1}0 while every g_n with n>m rejects it

for F(x)=x^2 write C_F(m,r) for the number of ≡_r classes among the unrestricted residuals of F at input depth m. Then C_F(m,r)=3^m whenever r≥m≥0, and C_F(m,m-1)=3^m-3 for every m≥2. The latter deficit is exactly three doubletons: for each σ in {-1,0,+1}, the two length-m extensions of σ^{m-1} by a trit other than σ are ≡_{m-1}-equivalent, and every other same-depth pair is distinguished

for F(x)=x^2 and r>=1, unrestricted ≡_r types at depth m>r inject into pairs (p mod 3^r, DZ^m(p^2) mod 3^r) for p in P_m. On the fibre p≡0 (mod 3^r): if m=2r the second coordinate runs exactly over the quadratic residues in Z/3^r Z, hence C_{x^2}(2r,r)<3^{2r}; if m>=3r the second coordinate is all of Z/3^r Z, via p=3^r + v 3^{m-r} for v in P_r. This decides the zero fibre, not C_{x^2}(m,r) for a general fibre. Cf. BTR-x2-C-band

for F(x)=x^2, r>=1 and m>=5r, every fibre p≡α (mod 3^r) of the interior map has second coordinate all of Z/3^r Z. Explicitly, for α,u in P_r the prefix p=α + u 3^r + 3^{m-r} lies in P_m, satisfies p≡α (mod 3^r), and DZ^m(p^2)≡2u + DZ^r(2α) (mod 3^r); the unit 2 makes u↦2u+const bijective. In particular no fibre stays incomplete for all m. This is not a first-saturation time of C_{x^2}(m,r). Cf. BTR-x2-C-interior
The LSD carry of normalizing the doubled trit stream 2 d_i, d_i in {-1,0,1}, stays in {-1,0,1}; 1 and -1 are reachable from 0.
V(c)=|c| strictly decreases under c |-> DZ(c+2d) whenever |c|>=2 and d is a trit.
Doubled-trit carry and output are odd: T(-c,-d)=-T(c,d) and the emitted trit negates.
The three carries -1,0,1 have pairwise distinct Mealy output signatures, so the 3-state machine is minimal.
The synthetic map T_3(c,d)=3 DZ(c+2d) satisfies c_n=3n along the all-+1 word, so the residual set is unbounded. This is not value-preserving normalization.
For T(n)=3n-lsd(n), lsd(T(n))=-lsd(n) and lsd(T^k(n))=(-1)^k lsd(n). Future LSD observations depend only on lsd(n).
Laboratory DZ is a left inverse of T: DZ(T(n))=n. Canonical T is the section I_{-lsd(n)}(n), not a constant-section I_a.
T(I_a(x))=9x+2a and lsd(T(I_a(x)))=-a, independent of the higher-digit residual x.
|T(n)| < |n| for all integers n, where T(n)=3n-lsd(n)
For T_λ(n)=3n-λ lsd(n), lsd(T_2(n))=lsd(n) and lsd(T_3(n))=0. The observational residual remains a trit; λ changes the residue map, not the need for the full integer.
For T(n)=3n-lsd(n), the length-2 integer jet satisfies J2(T(n))=(-lsd(n), lsd(n)). The map depends only on the first digit; every trit window (a,b) is sent to (-a,a).
The J2-orbit of T requires lsd(D^2(n)) or otherwise information beyond J2(n)
J2(T_2(n))=(lsd(n),0) and J2(T_3(n))=(0,0). Order-2 observation distinguishes T_2 from T, unlike the one-digit residual.

For T(n)=3n-lsd(n), the length-3 integer jet satisfies J3(T(n))=(-lsd(n), lsd(n), lsd(DZ(n))). Equivalently J3(T(n))=(-a,a,b) when J2(n)=(a,b). The third input digit is discarded. The map factors through J2.
J3(T(n)) is a function of lsd(n) alone
J3(T_2(n))=(lsd(n),0,lsd(DZ(n))) and J3(T_3(n))=(0,0,lsd(DZ(n))). T_3 collapses J1 and J2 but does not collapse J3: the second input digit survives.
D(x+y)=D(x)+D(y)+D(lsd(x)+lsd(y)). The missing state at the unary/Add boundary is D of the local digit sum.
D(x+y) is a function of (D(x), D(y), lsd(x+y))
If s,a,b are trits then D(s+a+b) is a trit. The streaming residual of trit addition is exactly {-1,0,1}. Three values occur on D(x)=D(y)=0, so the residual is minimal.
The shortcut map C(n)=n/2 (even) or (3n+1)/2 (odd) is well-defined on positive integers, and {1,2} is a 2-cycle.
V(n)=n strictly decreases on every shortcut step.
For every L≥1, n=2^L-1 realises L odd shortcut steps and C^L(n)=3^L-1>n. No residual n mod 2^L with blocks of length at most L certifies strict descent.
I_0(x)=3x. If |x|>1 then 3|x| is composite.
I_a(n) mod m depends only on n mod m.
The finite sieve residual gcd(n,210)=1 does not equal Prime: I_0(1)=3 is prime and I_0(211)=633 is composite, with 1≡211 (mod 210).
Equal length-L LSD jets have identical Prime continuation behaviour.
For λ=1 and |u|≤m, if |s|≤⌊m/2⌋ then |D(s+u)|≤⌊m/2⌋. The looser radius ⌈(m+1)/2⌉ from 3|D n|≤|n|+1 is not required.
For F_{λ,U_m}(s,u)=λ·D(s+u) with λ∈{1,2,3}, a finite invariant box containing 0 exists if λ≤2 or m≤1. If λ=3 and m≥2 the constant control u=2 yields s_n=3n.
Gain λ=3 forces unbounded residual independently of the raw alphabet U.
For F_{2,U_2} the origin-reachable set is {-2,0,2} while the smallest invariant interval is [-2,2]. Interval invariance is not the reachable residual.
r-way trit addition s'=D(s+a_1+⋯+a_r) is F_{1,U_r}: a trit sum of length r has absolute value at most r, so the λ=1 box |s|≤⌊r/2⌋ is invariant. The count 2⌊r/2⌋+1 equals 1,3,3,5 for r=1,2,3,4.
